Same 'Other damage' catch-all on Apple. Chains list water damage as an offered service but don't publish a price for it.
Apple's Mac repair page bundles it under an unpriced 'Other damage — inspection required' line. Neither chain publishes a price.

Not a named repair category anywhere checked. The actual fix varies by diagnosis (battery, logic board, or something else) and no source prices it as one line item. The Type Cover is sold as a separate accessory and has no line item at all on Microsoft's device repair-pricing table. Neither chain lists or prices Surface keyboard/Type Cover service.
